<popupnotification id="addon-webext-permissions-notification" hasicon="true" hidden="hidden">
    <popupnotificationcontent class="addon-webext-perm-notification-content" orient="vertical">
      <description id="addon-webext-perm-text" class="addon-webext-perm-text"/>
      <label id="addon-webext-perm-intro" class="addon-webext-perm-text"/>
      <label id ="addon-webext-perm-title-required" class="addon-webext-perm-title-required"/>
      <html:ul id="addon-webext-perm-list" class="addon-webext-perm-list"/>
      <description id="addon-webext-experiment-warning" class="addon-webext-experiment-warning"/>
      <hbox>
        <label data-l10n-id="webext-perms-learn-more" id="addon-webext-perm-info" is="text-link" class="popup-notification-learnmore-link"/>
      </hbox>
    </popupnotificationcontent>
  </popupnotification>

  <popupnotification id="addon-webext-expsuppressed-notification" hasicon="true" hidden="hidden">
    <popupnotificationcontent class="addon-webext-expsuppressed-notification-content" orient="vertical">
      <description data-l10n-id="webext-install-suppressed-details-2" class="addon-webext-expsuppressed-text"/>
      <hbox>
        <label data-l10n-id="webext-perms-learn-more" id="addon-webext-expsuppressed-info" is="text-link" class="popup-notification-learnmore-link"/>
      </hbox>
    </popupnotificationcontent>
  </popupnotification>
